title: TopologyV2OverlayLayerSave
description: Optional save/template metadata attached to a materialized topology overlay layer.

portability.description: Whether the layer can be saved portably, only for the current scope, or not at all.

requiredCatalogIds.description: Semantic catalog ids the saved layer depends on when reopened later.

requiredGraphCapabilities.description: Optional graph/runtime capability ids required for this layer when a saved custom view is reopened.
